input: Finally, cost needs an outcome attached. Simon Willison argues that token prices are not readily comparable without knowing how many tokens a model consumes to achieve a goal in an agent workflow. That is not a measured small-project delivery study. Our qualified conclusion is to assess actual output, representative behavior, and task-level expenditure together. Independent controlled research, maintenance follow-up, and representative evidence for budget-constrained and accessibility users remain missing. Favorable signals are clues—not proof of verified delivery.
